rundown: Hurricanes beat Oilers 7-4 at Lenovo Center in Raleigh, NC in front of 18,855. Hurricanes led 5-4 after two periods and never looked back. The 2nd period decided it: Hurricanes won it 5-2.
11 goals in all. Hurricanes's last: Alexander Nikishin Goal Slap Shot, assists: Mark Jankowski (2), Taylor Hall (5), 3rd period 17:57.
Leading the way — Oilers: Leon Draisaitl 1 goal, 2 pts; Connor McDavid 2 ast. Hurricanes: Andrei Svechnikov 2 goals; Sebastian Aho 2 ast, 3 pts.
Where Hurricanes won it: they outshot them 36-15 and scored 3 on the power play to 2.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Hurricanes closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 1.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 11, over by 4.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 21, 12:55 PM ET. It had Oilers 43% and Hurricanes 57%, projecting Oilers 2.8 – Hurricanes 3.2 (6 total, Hurricanes by 0.4).

Final: Oilers 4 – Hurricanes 7. Right winner: it had Hurricanes at 57%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Oilers came in with a 7% above average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (17-4-3, 3.9 scored and 2.7 allowed a game over 24 games), worth about 81 and 81 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.8, they scored 4 (+1.2 goals, 44% over); projected to allow 3.2, they allowed 7 (+3.8 goals, 118% over).

Hurricanes came in with a 11% above average attack and a 8% stingier than average defense (16-3-3, 4 scored and 2.2 allowed a game over 22 games), worth about 79 and 79 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.2, they scored 7 (+3.8 goals, 118% over); projected to allow 2.8, they allowed 4 (+1.2 goals, 44% over).

The bigger miss was Hurricanes' scoring (+3.8 goals against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 11 against 6 projected (+5), about the 98th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Hurricanes by 3 against Hurricanes by 0.4 projected, about the 85th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
CAR ML (-218) at -218: the algo gave it 65% vs 66% fair (-0.8 pts) — won (+0.5u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 68%). EDM ML (+180) at +180: the algo gave it 35% vs 34% fair (+0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 32%). CAR -1.5 (+120) at +120: the algo gave it 42% vs 44% fair (-1.2 pts) — won (+1.2u); same number as the close. EDM +1.5 (-142) at -142: the algo gave it 58% vs 56% fair (+1.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (+110) at +110: the algo gave it 45% vs 46% fair (-0.4 pts) — won (+1.1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-130) at -130: the algo gave it 55% vs 54% fair (+0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): spread: 50% of bets on Oilers, 60% of the money — Hurricanes covered; total: 61% of bets on the over, 75% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 27% of bets on Oilers, 64% of the money.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.681 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +2.3 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 114 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.947 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections so far: Oilers attack ×0.978, defense ×0.960 (9 games); Hurricanes attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.6 goals), no bet.
